text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Thank you for the shaved ice.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure this is alright? Relaxing 
like this right in the middle of our 
spartan training...
choice_data_list: Resting is part of training, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Part of training... Oh, I've read about 
that in a novel before!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Watching others train while taking a break 
lets you pick up their techniques and 
notice their habits—I see, so that was 
your intention...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't really the intention; I purely 
meant to take a breather, but— Zenno Rob 
Roy looked so happy, so I let it be.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Watching the training of various heroes, 
learning from it, and making it your own 
flesh and blood... Isn't it wonderful...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what kind of hero awaits on the 
beach—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Speaking of heroes, that's ME!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When you think of heroes, you think of 
me!!

"Making that resounding declaration to the 
heavens was a senior Umamusume who had 
achieved dazzling success—"

It was T.M. Opera O, the "Century's End 
Overlord" who completely conquered the 
classic Senior GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, um, th-that's true! When it comes 
to heroes, it might just be... Opera 
O-san...!?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's not a "maybe," Rob Roy. Hero, king, 
work of art, and every other title in the 
world—I shall claim them all myself!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's right...! Then, could I 
please observe Opera O-san's training—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Observing? That's fine too, but I've got a 
much better idea.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Step onto my stage as well!! Only in the 
presence of an opposing force does my 
beauty truly radiate!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Rob Roy-kun, as a special treat, 
I shall grant you a role as well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... A monster brimming with 
power, or a fairy who patiently obeys my 
commands— Choose whichever you like!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... er...! Trainer, which one do you 
think is better!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-Then, a monster, please...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!! Then you're the monster, and I'm 
the heroic protagonist!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(If I had to choose, I would have 
preferred to be a hero too...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Act One! By the way, <username> Trainer, please 
play every other role yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of opera is this gonna turn 
into... heh!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: R-Rawr! I'm gonna eat you up~...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
La la la~♪ Forgive everything, love 
everything~♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-I'm gonna eat it, you know!? Are 
you sure!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Because the Overlord is~♪ oh so 
merciful~♪"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ugh, the plot is all over the place...!
choice_data_list: What kind of scene was this again...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is supposed to be the scene where 
Opera O-san's protagonist seals away the 
evil monster... right...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You can't just let that slide~...! Like, 
don't you have any thoughts on sticking to 
the original story... or staying in 
character...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Not a chance!!!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Is it not there...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because this is my opera, you see. Only 
when I soar freely across the stage can 
the audience truly bask in my beauty.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I rule over my own stage. That is the true 
path of the Overlord!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san... ...That's amazing. I could 
never—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still, Rob Roy. Please don't forget.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You, too—are standing upon this stage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Me too...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whether you are merely part of the stage 
set, or a co-star making waves on the 
King's stage— that all depends on what 
unfolds from here on out!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, show me! Show me what kind of story 
you will weave!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I... want to be a hero. No, I need to 
be a hero...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So from here on, allow me to tell the tale 
of how a monster became a hero...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!! But I have no intention of 
giving up the leading role. Nowâ

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Raise the curtain, if you please!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O Supreme Overlord, with your 
forgiveness... I have finally regained my 
true form.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I am no longer a monster. As of today, I 
have cast aside this wild magical 
power...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the mist has finally cleared. The 
storm has ceased, by my glorious majesty!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us return in triumph, my friend. The 
wondrous new world you have carved open 
awaits us!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-Then I'll go with a fairy...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!! Then you're the fairy, and I'm 
the heroic protagonist!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(If I had to choose, I'd rather be a hero 
too...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Act One! By the way, <username> Trainer, please 
play every other role yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of opera is this gonna turn 
into... heh!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-All hail the Supreme Overlord! What 
shall we subject those fools to next?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
La la la~♪ Forgive everything, love 
everything~♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-What about the revenge... What 
happened to the revenge you ordered me to 
carry out?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Because the Overlord is~♪ oh so 
merciful~♪"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ugh, the plot is all over the place...!
choice_data_list: What kind of scene was this again...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is supposed to be the scene where 
Opera O-san's protagonist commands the 
fairy to punish their nemesis... right...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You can't just let that slide~...! Like, 
don't you have any thoughts on sticking to 
the original story... or staying in 
character...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: No way!!!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Is it not there...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because this is my opera, you see. Only 
when I soar freely across the stage can 
the audience truly bask in my beauty.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I rule over my own stage. That is the true 
path of the Overlord!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Opera O-san really is amazing, after 
all. I could never have that kind of 
confidence—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still, Rob Roy. Please don't forget.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You, too—are standing upon this stage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Me too...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whether you are merely part of the stage 
set, or a co-star making waves on the 
King's stage— that all depends on what 
unfolds from here on out!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, show me! Show me what kind of story 
you will weave!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A tale... woven by me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I want to become a hero. No, I have to 
be a hero...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So from here on, allow me to tell the tale 
of how a fairy became a hero...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!! But I have no intention of 
giving up the leading role. Nowâ

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Raise the curtain, if you please!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O Supreme Overlord, forgiving our enemies 
alongside you... I have finally regained 
my true form.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I am no longer a tiny fairy. As of today, 
I have cast aside this wild magical 
power...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the mist has finally cleared. The 
storm has ceased, by my glorious majesty!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us return in triumph, my friend. The 
wondrous new world you have carved open 
awaits us!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! Was that not a magnificent 
stage? You may shower me with all the 
praise you wish!!
choice_data_list: You two looked like real heroes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: C-Come on, you're kidding...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Still, somehow... I feel like I've 
learned something truly important.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"No matter the stage, once you step onto 
it, it belongs to you."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I won't forget. Thank you very much, 
Opera O-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, praise me to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You should walk your own story. If you 
become a hero who stands alongside me one 
day, our paths will surely cross again.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Until the day we meet again!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes! Someday, on the turf!!
